:::{#thm-matrix-column-of-rows}
#### A matrix is a column of its rows

An $m \times n$ [matrix](#def-matrix) $\matr{A}$ is the [column vector](#def-column-vector) whose entries
are its [rows](#def-matrix-row):

$$
\matr{A} =
\begin{bmatrix}
\matr{A}_{1,:} \\
\vdots \\
\matr{A}_{m,:}
\end{bmatrix}.
$$

:::
